Date: 02/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 187 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of using disabled access parking placards in violation of the provisions of this bill and the penalties imposed.
Gerald H. Allen, Chair Person
Transportation and Energy
